I just figured I'd mention it since we're cataloging these. It's nice when someone is easygoing about it, though I personally find it more meaningful when people have a strong preference.

I always prefer when people have a clear preference rather than just going with whatever. It feels more intentional and more real, you know? Like they're owning a piece of their identity.
